arxiv-1610-02283.title: Transition to a Moist Greenhouse with CO 2 and solar forcing
arxiv-1610-02283.creator: Max Popp 1,2⋆, Hauke Schmidt 1 & Jochem Marotzke 1
arxiv-1610-02283.description: Abstract Water-rich planets such as Earth are expected to become eventually uninhabitable, because liquid water does not remain stable at the surface as surface temperatures increase with the solar luminosity over time. Whether a large increase of atmospheric concentrations of greenhouse gases such as CO 2 could also destroy the habitability of water-rich planets has remained unclear.

arxiv-2403-03984.title: Pre-supernova evolution and final fate of stellar mergers and accretors of binary mass transfer
arxiv-2403-03984.creator: F.R.N. Schneider, Ph. Podsiadlowski, E. Laplace
arxiv-2403-03984.description: Abstract The majority of massive stars are expected to exchange mass or merge with a companion during their lives. This immediately implies that most supernovae (SNe) are from such post-mass-exchange objects. Here, we explore how mass accretion and merging affect the pre-SN structures of stars and their final fates.

arxiv-2412-09089.title: Probing the low-energy particle content of blazar jets through MeV observations
arxiv-2412-09089.creator: F. Tavecchio, L. Nava, A. Sciaccaluga, P. Coppi
arxiv-2412-09089.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by F. Tavecchio, L. Nava, A. Sciaccaluga, P. Coppi. Many of the blazars observed by Fermi actually have the peak of their time-averaged gamma-ray emission outside the ∼ \sim GeV Fermi energy range, at ∼ \sim MeV energies. The detailed shape of the emission spectrum around the ∼ \sim MeV peak places important constraints on acceleration and radiation mechanisms in the blazar jet and may not be the simple broken power law obtained by extrapolating from the observed X-ray and GeV gamma-ray spectra.

arxiv-2502-18324.title: Improving success probability in the LHZ parity embedding by computing with quantum walks.
arxiv-2502-18324.creator: Jemma Bennett, Nicholas Chancellor, Viv Kendon, Wolfgang Lechner
arxiv-2502-18324.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jemma Bennett, Nicholas Chancellor, Viv Kendon, Wolfgang Lechner. The LHZ parity embedding is one of the front-running methods for implementing difficult-to-engineer long-range interactions in quantum optimisation problems. Continuous-time quantum walks are a leading approach for solving quantum optimisation problems. Due to them populating excited states, quantum walks can avoid the exponential gap closing problems seen in other continuous-time techniques such as quantum annealing and adiabatic quantum computation (AQC).

arxiv-2507-21677.title: On Zel’manov’s global nilpotence theorem for Engel Lie algebras
arxiv-2507-21677.creator: Michael Vaughan-Lee
arxiv-2507-21677.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Michael Vaughan-Lee. I give a proof of Zel’manov’s theorem that if L L is an n n -Engel Lie algebra over a field F F of characteristic zero, then L L is (globally) nilpotent. This is a very important result which extends Kostrikin’s theorem that L L is locally nilpotent if the characteristic of F F is zero or some prime p > n p>n .

arxiv-2511-09476.title: Nilpotence of η \eta in étale motivic spectra
arxiv-2511-09476.creator: Klaus Mattis, Swann Tubach
arxiv-2511-09476.description: Abstract We show that every object of the stable étale motivic homotopy category over any scheme is η \eta -complete. In some cases we show that in fact the fourth power of η \eta is null, whereas the third power of η \eta is always nonvanishing, similar to the situation in topology.

pmc-11512855.creator: Douglas V. N. P. Oliveira, Edyta Biskup, Colm J. O’Rourke, Julie L. Hentze, Jesper B. Andersen, Claus Høgdall, Estrid V. Høgdall

IntroductionEpithelial ovarian cancer (EOC) represents a significant health challenge, with high-grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC) being the most common subtype. pmc-12592467.title: Synthesis of polylactic acid/Henna polymer composite and its application in optimizing drilling fluid rheology and filtration performance
pmc-12592467.creator: Chou-Yi Hsu, Abhinav Kumar, Muhamed Hussain, Mohd Shukri Ab Yajid, N. Beemkumar, Manoj Kumar Ojha, Varinder Singh, Vatsal Jain, Parminder Singh, Samim Sherzod
pmc-12592467.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Efficient extraction of subsurface resources relies heavily on the performance of drilling fluids, which necessitates constant innovation in their formulation. This study introduces a novel Polylactic Acid/Henna composite for significant enhancement of drilling fluid properties. The composites was characterized via Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM), Energy-Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDS), and Fourier-Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (FTIR), confirming the uniform Henna particles dispersion in PLA matrix.
